notes.title: Elseworld 6.1 patch
notes.notes:
There was a game breaking bug that one user pointed out.. (Thank you so much by the way!!) ...which could get you stuck in a loop after Tuug (Tuesday). You would just keep repeating the day over and over again. It is now fixed. If you have a save before talking to Ragnuri in the dream please go back to there. Otherwise you may have to do Tuesday one more time. Just hold control to skip thru dialogue you have done before. The best stuff happens after Wega (Wednesday).

Have fun and I am sorry for not knowing about this problem earlier,
Betazero and Nim

notes.title: Elseworld V6
notes.notes:
Version 6 is finished - Happy Frig! The day the inhabitants of Elseworld celebrate the ones who are lost. This is the largest Elseworld update yet by far. 3.5+ gigs of new content. What?! We can't even share too many of the images without spoiling this. I hope you like it. Also, the next version of Futanun is in there :). A VERY interactive game on your TV. Maybe too interactive?

3.5+ gigs of new videos - around 400 videos.

The next version of Elseworld (V7) is going to have a Wizardry style Rogue Like dungeon for Satu - Risk day. With a very adult twist for sure. Like enemies that will require you to do certain things in order to "Beat" them.

Betazero & Nim

notes.title: Character identify theft fixed.
notes.notes:
So Nina from Futanun suffered some identity theft from Nim. (When I imported Futanun into Elseworld there were two overlapping defined names...) Nim had stolen Nina's name...Punk... We have restored Nina's name and Nim has been punished. But I think she liked it...

This update may seem big for just a name fix and that is because it has the start of Version 6 in there.

Thanks,
Betazero

notes.title: Elseworld V5 released
notes.notes:
Version 5 The Hunt Continued is finished. Izi takes you on a little trip to her favorite hunting grounds. What will you hunt? Will you even hunt? One thing is for sure things are about to get wet and dirty.  Will you make it back home? See the rest of day 4. Also, play a new mini-game visual novel inside Elseworld. 

What's new in V5:

225 new videos - +2.0 gigs

A new Mini-game called Futanun - You are a woman who decides to become a nun but has a special extra appendage...What could go wrong? The introduction is now inside Elseworld. It will become a playable game on the TV and laptop.
